title: Despite CS’ assurance, non-gazetted employees of 5 new GMCs continue strike across J&K

ai.summary: Non-gazetted employees of five new Jammu and Kashmir Government Medical Colleges continue strike demanding immediate notification of service recruitment rules, which have been pending for nearly seven years.

facts.claim: non-gazetted cadre employees of five newly established Government Medical Colleges across Jammu and Kashmir continued their agitation
facts.quote: non-gazetted cadre employees of five newly established Government Medical Colleges across Jammu and Kashmir continued their agitation

facts.claim: employees have been on strike for the last nine days
facts.quote: The employees, who are on strike for the last nine days

facts.claim: employees are demanding immediate notification of service recruitment rules, which have remained pending since the establishment of these medical colleges nearly seven years ago
facts.quote: are demanding immediate notification of service recruitment rules, which have remained pending since the establishment of these medical colleges nearly seven years ago

facts.claim: this is the third agitation by the employees over the issue this year
facts.quote: This is the third agitation by the employees over the issue this year

facts.claim: the ongoing strike has affected healthcare services across the five medical colleges
facts.quote: The ongoing strike has affected healthcare services across the five medical colleges

facts.claim: employees are abstaining from duties except emergency services
facts.quote: employees are abstaining from duties except emergency services

facts.claim: elective surgeries have been delayed, while outpatient department (OPD) services have also been hit
facts.quote: Elective surgeries have been delayed, while outpatient department (OPD) services have also been hit

facts.claim: Chief Secretary Sajjan Singh Yadav assured employees that the entire process would be completed within one month
facts.quote: He informed them that the Health and Medical Education Department had submitted the draft service recruitment rules to the Finance Department for further processing. The Chief Secretary assured the employees that the entire process would be completed within one month

facts.claim: employees said they will continue strike until the service recruitment rules are formally notified
facts.quote: We welcome the assurance given by the Chief Secretary, but the Coordination Committee has already decided that the strike will continue until the recruitment rules are notified

ai.background_note: Non-gazetted employees of five new Jammu and Kashmir Government Medical Colleges have been striking for nearly seven years over pending service recruitment rules, with this being their third agitation this year.
